catalogue: Australian sanitary plumbing, sanitary drainage and onsite wastewater components

objects.name: sanitary plumbing system
objects.definition: The traps, fixture discharge pipes, branches, stacks and vents that carry wastewater from fixtures to the point where sanitary drainage begins while protecting occupied spaces from sewer gases.
functions: Carry discharge with air movement and trap protection

ncc_references.relationship: Sanitary plumbing from fixture discharge outlets to the sanitary-drainage connection.

cad.pattern: Trapped fixture branches joining stacks or graded discharge pipes with a coordinated vent network
cad.placement: Within rooms, service cavities, floors, ceilings and shafts between fixtures and drainage
cad.opening: Requires coordinated penetrations, sleeves, seals and access
cad.load: Pipe contents and discharge forces carried by clips, brackets and building structure

notes: Plumbing and drainage are separated by a regulatory boundary even when the same pipe material continues through it.

objects.name: sanitary drainage system
objects.definition: The graded drains, junctions, gullies, traps, inspection points and any pumping equipment that carry wastewater from the sanitary-plumbing boundary to a sewer connection or onsite wastewater system.
functions: Carry wastewater away from the building
Provide overflow relief, ventilation and maintenance access
Connect the property to sewer or onsite treatment

ncc_references.relationship: Sanitary drainage from sanitary plumbing to sewer or onsite wastewater management.

cad.pattern: Graded underground or underfloor drain network with accessible maintenance and overflow points
cad.placement: Below slabs, under suspended floors, in ground and at the property connection
cad.end: Sewer connection or onsite wastewater inlet
cad.opening: Inspection and relief openings remain accessible
cad.load: Soil, traffic and building actions resisted through pipe class, embedment and protection

notes: The property sewer connection is a physical endpoint; authority ownership and approval are metadata.

objects.name: fixture discharge pipe
objects.definition: A pipe carrying wastewater from one fixture trap or appliance outlet to a branch, stack or sanitary drain.
functions: Carry wastewater without losing the trap seal
Connect to a larger discharge path
not_synonyms: branch discharge pipe serving several fixtures

cad.pattern: One routed run from fixture trap to branch, stack or drain
cad.placement: Immediately downstream of the fixture trap
cad.opening: Passes through coordinated holes or sleeves
cad.load: Contents and discharge reactions carried by pipe supports

objects.name: branch discharge pipe
objects.definition: A usually graded sanitary-plumbing pipe receiving discharge from two or more fixture discharge pipes before joining a stack or sanitary drain.
functions: Maintain drainage flow and air movement
Connect a fixture group to the main discharge path
not_synonyms: branch drain below the plumbing boundary

cad.pattern: Graded branch with swept fixture junctions
cad.placement: Within floor, ceiling or service zone upstream of stack or drain
cad.opening: Coordinated penetrations and access
cad.load: Supported along route and at changes of direction

objects.name: sanitary stack
objects.definition: A substantially vertical discharge pipe receiving wastewater from branch or fixture discharge pipes on one or more levels.
functions: Work with vents to control pressure

cad.pattern: Vertical pipe with swept branch junctions and base transition
cad.placement: Service shaft, wall cavity or exposed service zone
cad.end: Stack vent or highest branch zone
cad.opening: Floor and roof penetrations coordinated and sealed
cad.load: Vertical pipe weight restrained by stack supports and clamps

notes: Stack describes the discharge role; a vent-only vertical pipe is a different object.

objects.name: sanitary-stack base assembly
objects.definition: The bottom bend, junction, access fitting and support arrangement that changes stack flow from vertical to the graded drain.
functions: Turn vertical discharge into the drain

cad.pattern: Swept base bend with downstream access and restraint
cad.placement: At bottom of sanitary stack before graded drain
cad.opening: Access cap remains removable
cad.load: Discharge thrust and stack weight transferred to support

objects.name: sanitary-stack offset assembly
objects.definition: A pair of bends and connecting pipe shifting a sanitary stack sideways around structure or services while preserving its discharge and ventilation function.
functions: Provide support and access around the offset

cad.pattern: Two bends and intervening offset run
cad.placement: Where stack must pass structure or another service
cad.opening: Requires coordinated clearance and access
cad.load: Offset weight and thrust restrained independently

objects.name: sanitary ventilation system
objects.definition: The connected vent pipes, vented stack portions, air-admittance devices and terminals that move air through sanitary plumbing and drainage to protect trap seals and discharge flow.
functions: Release foul air at a safe terminal or admit air through approved devices

cad.pattern: Vent branches rising to common vents, stacks or approved terminals
cad.placement: Above trap weirs and discharge connections through service zones to terminals
cad.start: Protected branch, trap or drain ventilation point
cad.opening: Roof and wall penetrations are flashed and kept clear
cad.load: Vent pipe carried by clips and structure

notes: An air-admittance valve admits air but does not by itself provide positive-pressure relief or an outdoor foul-air outlet.

objects.name: branch vent pipe
objects.definition: A vent pipe connected to a fixture discharge or branch discharge pipe to protect one or more traps from pressure changes.
functions: Admit or move air near protected fixtures
Connect the branch to a vent stack or header

cad.pattern: Small branch rising from discharge pipe to vent network
cad.placement: Near the protected trap or fixture branch
cad.opening: Coordinated wall and ceiling penetrations
cad.load: Self-weight carried by clips

objects.name: vent stack
objects.definition: A substantially vertical vent-only pipe receiving branch vents and connecting them to an outdoor vent terminal or another permitted vent path.
functions: Connect the vent network to its terminal

cad.pattern: Vertical vent-only pipe with branch connections
cad.placement: Service cavity or shaft
cad.opening: Roof penetration flashed where used
cad.load: Pipe weight restrained by stack clamps

objects.name: stack vent
objects.definition: The upper continuation of a sanitary discharge stack above its highest discharge connection, used as part of the ventilation path.
functions: Limit pressure changes in the discharge stack
Terminate outdoors or connect to a header vent

cad.pattern: Continuation above highest stack branch
cad.placement: From top discharge branch through roof or to header vent
cad.opening: Roof penetration requires compatible flashing
cad.load: Pipe and wind loads transferred to supports

notes: Stack vent and vent stack are different arrangements despite the reversed words.

objects.name: relief vent
objects.definition: A vent connection installed to relieve pressure in a discharge stack, branch or drain at a selected location in addition to the main vent route.
functions: Protect trap seals in complex layouts
Connect a pressure zone to the vent network

cad.pattern: Additional vent link between pressure zone and vent network
cad.placement: At designed stack or branch relief location
cad.end: Vent stack, header or outdoor path
cad.opening: Coordinated penetrations
cad.load: Self-weight carried by clips

objects.name: common vent
objects.definition: A vent arrangement serving two nearby fixture traps or discharge connections through a shared vent path.

cad.pattern: Shared vent rising from paired discharge connections
cad.placement: Between or adjacent to paired fixtures
cad.opening: Wall or ceiling penetration as routed
cad.load: Self-weight carried by clips

objects.name: header vent
objects.definition: A vent pipe joining two or more stack vents or vent stacks before one combined outdoor terminal.

cad.pattern: High-level graded manifold joining vent risers
cad.placement: Above highest connected discharge points and below terminal
cad.opening: Roof penetration at final terminal
cad.load: Header supported along route

objects.name: air-admittance valve
objects.definition: A one-way mechanical valve that opens under negative pressure to admit air into sanitary pipework and closes to contain foul air.

cad.pattern: One accessible upright valve at the end of a permitted vent branch
cad.placement: Above protected spill level in a ventilated accessible location
cad.opening: Air inlets and maintenance removal envelope remain clear
cad.load: Valve carried by vent pipe or bracket

notes: An AAV cannot be treated as an interchangeable cap; its airflow, location and system role are selected design data.

objects.name: sanitary vent terminal cowl
objects.definition: A weather-resistant terminal fitting at the open end of a sanitary vent that keeps the airway open while discouraging debris, animals or direct rain entry.
functions: Limit entry of debris and animals

cad.pattern: One cowl on each selected open vent terminal
cad.placement: Top of outdoor vent termination
cad.opening: Free airway remains unobstructed
cad.load: Wind load transferred to terminal pipe

objects.name: sanitary vent roof flashing
objects.definition: A shaped roof flashing and flexible or formed collar sealing the weatherproof junction around a sanitary vent pipe through the roof.
functions: Shed roof water around the penetration
Connect the vent penetration to the roof weathering system

cad.pattern: Flanged weathering piece centred on vent penetration
cad.placement: Integrated with roof cladding around vent
cad.opening: Central collar grips vent without blocking movement
cad.load: Wind and weather loads transferred through flashing fixings

notes: The selected flashing must also match the roof-cladding system; the vent standard alone does not settle that junction.

objects.name: fixture trap assembly
objects.definition: A shaped fitting or integral fixture passage that retains a water seal between a fixture outlet and sanitary pipework while allowing wastewater to discharge.
functions: Block foul air with a water seal
Provide cleaning or removal access where the selected trap permits

cad.pattern: One trapped path at each fixture requiring an individual trap
cad.placement: Immediately below or integral with fixture outlet
cad.opening: Cleaning access remains reachable
cad.load: Trap and contained water supported by fixture or pipe brackets

notes: The retained water is functionally critical but can be represented as state metadata unless a section or simulation needs its volume.

objects.name: P-trap
objects.definition: A fixture trap whose outlet leaves generally horizontally after the water-seal bend, commonly used where the discharge enters a wall or horizontal branch.
functions: Turn fixture discharge to a generally horizontal outlet
Connect to a wall or branch waste

cad.pattern: U-bend with horizontal outlet leg
cad.placement: Below fixture before wall or branch connection
cad.opening: Union or cleaning access remains reachable
cad.load: Supported by fixture outlet and pipe connection without strain

objects.name: S-trap
objects.definition: A fixture trap whose outlet turns down after the water-seal bend, commonly used where discharge passes through the floor.
functions: Turn fixture discharge to a downward outlet
Connect to a floor penetration or vertical branch

cad.pattern: Water-seal bend followed by downward outlet
cad.placement: Below fixture over a floor discharge point
cad.opening: Floor penetration set out to selected trap
cad.load: Supported without loading fixture outlet

notes: Trap form affects siphonage risk and venting; it is not merely a rotated P-trap in the data model.

objects.name: bottle trap
objects.definition: A compact vessel-shaped fixture trap with an internal partition or tube creating a water seal and a removable lower body for cleaning.
functions: Fit within a compact exposed fixture zone

cad.pattern: Vertical bottle body with top inlet, side outlet and removable base
cad.placement: Exposed below basin or similar fixture
cad.opening: Removal envelope below trap remains clear
cad.load: Trap body supported by threaded connections without strain

objects.name: integral fixture trap
objects.definition: A water-seal passage formed as part of a fixture body rather than installed as a separate detachable fitting.
functions: Retain a water seal within the fixture
Carry fixture discharge to its connector

cad.pattern: Internal curved passage within fixture body
cad.placement: Integral to toilet pan, urinal or selected fixture
cad.opening: Access follows fixture design
cad.load: Part of fixture body

objects.name: trap-primer assembly
objects.definition: A valve or controlled water source and small pipe that periodically delivers water to a floor-waste or other infrequently used trap to replace evaporation losses.
functions: Maintain water in an infrequently used trap
Reduce loss of the foul-air seal
Deliver a small controlled priming flow

cad.pattern: Small protected water branch from primer control to trap inlet
cad.placement: Between approved water source or fixture event and selected trap
cad.opening: Service access at valve and trap connection
cad.load: Small pipe supported independently

notes: A trap primer introduces a cross-connection question and must not be modelled as an unprotected water pipe pushed into a waste fitting.

objects.name: trap-primer valve
objects.definition: A mechanical, pressure-operated, electronic or fixture-activated valve metering water into a trap-primer line.
functions: Close the water source between priming events

cad.pattern: One accessible control valve feeding one or more primer lines
cad.placement: On protected water branch near served traps or activating fixture
cad.opening: Removal and adjustment envelope remains clear
cad.load: Valve supported from pipe or bracket

objects.name: trap-primer line
objects.definition: The small pipe carrying metered priming water from a trap-primer device to the receiving trap.
functions: Discharge without creating an unprotected cross-connection

cad.pattern: Small continuous run to trap primer connection
cad.placement: Concealed or exposed between primer and trap
cad.opening: Protected at penetrations
cad.load: Tube carried by clips

objects.name: drain-waste-vent pipe
objects.definition: A pipe selected for gravity sanitary discharge or ventilation rather than for pressurised water supply.
functions: Carry sanitary discharge or ventilation air
Accept compatible DWV fittings and joints
Form the routed plumbing or drainage network

cad.pattern: Straight or routed cylindrical runs joined by compatible fittings
cad.placement: As sanitary discharge, drain or vent routes
cad.opening: Requires selected penetration and access treatment
cad.load: Contents and pipe mass carried by embedment or supports

notes: DWV is a service family; selected material and product series determine actual diameters and sockets.

objects.name: PVC-U DWV pipe
objects.definition: Rigid unplasticised polyvinyl-chloride pipe made as a compatible drain, waste and vent system with solvent-cement or rubber-ring joints according to its application.

cad.pattern: Rigid pipe lengths with integral or fitting sockets
cad.placement: Above ground or buried as allowed by selected pipe series
cad.opening: Allow for sockets, expansion and penetrations
cad.load: Supported or embedded to selected pipe stiffness and loading

objects.name: DWV bend
objects.definition: A curved drain, waste or vent fitting changing pipe direction through a selected angle and sweep radius.
functions: Maintain a smooth discharge or air path

cad.pattern: Curved fitting inserted at direction change
cad.placement: At routed change in pipe alignment
cad.opening: Socket engagement included
cad.load: Supported near change of direction

notes: A short bend, long bend and paired bends can behave differently; retain the selected fitting geometry.

objects.name: DWV junction
objects.definition: A swept branch fitting joining a smaller or equal drain or discharge pipe into a continuing pipe in the intended direction of flow.

cad.pattern: Angled branch merging into main barrel
cad.placement: At fixture, branch, stack or drain connection
cad.opening: Socket engagement and cleanout access coordinated
cad.load: Supported to avoid joint strain

objects.name: DWV tee
objects.definition: A three-way DWV fitting with a side branch generally square to the main barrel, shaped for a selected ventilation or vertical-discharge connection.
functions: Connect a branch to a vertical or vent pipe
Divide or combine airflow where selected

cad.pattern: Right-angle branch fitting with selected sweep
cad.placement: At approved stack, discharge or vent branch
cad.start: Main and branch inlets as selected
cad.opening: Socket engagement included
cad.load: Supported near junction

notes: Do not rotate a generic tee into a graded-drain junction without confirming the fitting is intended for that flow direction.

objects.name: DWV reducer
objects.definition: A fitting connecting two different DWV pipe sizes while preserving the selected alignment of the invert, crown or centreline.
functions: Control the alignment through the size change

cad.pattern: Tapered or stepped connector between pipe sizes
cad.placement: At designed size transition
cad.opening: Socket engagement included
cad.load: Supported to prevent settlement at transition

objects.name: DWV coupling
objects.definition: A straight socket, slip, rubber-ring or mechanical fitting joining two aligned DWV pipe ends of the same or nominated compatible size.
functions: Provide the selected rigid or flexible joint

cad.pattern: Short sleeve overlapping two aligned pipe ends
cad.placement: At straight pipe joint or repair
cad.opening: Pipe insertion depths retained
cad.load: Joint supported as required by system

objects.name: DWV expansion joint
objects.definition: A telescoping or sleeved fitting allowing controlled axial movement in a DWV pipe run while maintaining its seal.
functions: Maintain a watertight and airtight joint
Protect fixed branches and supports from movement stress

cad.pattern: Telescoping socket with movement allowance
cad.placement: At calculated movement location in long or constrained run
cad.opening: Inspection of insertion mark remains possible where required
cad.load: Movement controlled by anchors and guides rather than joint friction alone

objects.name: DWV inspection fitting
objects.definition: A bend, tee, junction or short pipe fitting with a removable sealed cap positioned to permit inspection, cleaning or testing of sanitary pipework.
functions: Provide tool access to the pipe bore
Reseal the sanitary system after use

cad.pattern: Capped branch or access face aligned for cleaning
cad.placement: At stack bases, direction changes and selected maintenance points
cad.opening: Full cap and tool-removal envelope stays accessible
cad.load: Cap contains test and discharge pressure

objects.name: DWV end cap
objects.definition: A permanently jointed or removable fitting closing the end of a DWV pipe or unused branch while maintaining the sanitary seal.
functions: Contain foul air and test pressure
Permit future connection when deliberately removable

cad.pattern: Closed face at pipe socket or spigot
cad.placement: At unused branch or test end
cad.opening: Removal envelope retained if reusable
cad.load: Cap resists test and incidental internal pressure

objects.name: drain test plug
objects.definition: A removable mechanical, pneumatic or screw plug temporarily sealing a sanitary pipe opening so a defined pipe section can be tested or protected during construction.
functions: Hold test water or air as selected

cad.pattern: Temporary disc or bladder inside accessible pipe opening
cad.placement: At test boundary or construction protection point
cad.opening: Access retained for safe removal
cad.load: Test pressure resisted by selected plug and restraint

notes: The construction model should flag the plug for removal unless it is deliberately retained as an accessible test point.

objects.name: sanitary pipe clip
objects.definition: A ring, saddle or snap clip fixing a sanitary discharge or vent pipe to the building while allowing the selected restraint or movement.

cad.pattern: Repeated around pipe at designed spacing and direction changes
cad.placement: Between pipe and wall, framing, slab or support rail
cad.opening: Fastener penetration into verified substrate
cad.load: Transfers pipe and contents to substrate

objects.name: sanitary pipe hanger assembly
objects.definition: A rod, bracket, channel and clamp arrangement suspending a horizontal sanitary pipe below a floor, roof or support frame.

cad.pattern: Repeated vertical hangers carrying graded horizontal pipe
cad.placement: Between overhead structure and pipe
cad.opening: Anchor holes coordinated with structure
cad.load: Transfers pipe, contents and imposed actions upward

objects.name: sanitary stack clamp
objects.definition: A loadbearing clamp or bracket around a vertical sanitary stack that transfers pipe weight and restrains movement at selected levels.

cad.pattern: Clamp at selected floor or wall support levels
cad.placement: Around vertical stack adjacent to structure
cad.opening: Bracket anchors coordinate with shaft construction
cad.load: Transfers stack dead load and movement reactions

objects.name: sanitary pipe penetration sleeve
objects.definition: A short larger sleeve or formed opening liner separating a sanitary pipe from concrete, masonry or framing at a penetration and preserving the selected movement and sealing zone.
functions: Separate pipe from abrasive or incompatible substrate
Provide space for movement, waterproofing, acoustic or fire treatment

cad.pattern: Short sleeve centred through host construction
cad.placement: At wall, floor, footing or slab penetration
cad.opening: Annular zone assigned to compatible seal or movement treatment
cad.load: Sleeve is not assumed to support the service pipe

notes: Fire, waterproofing, termite and structural requirements remain separate coordinated systems around the sleeve.

objects.name: graded sanitary drain
objects.definition: A below-ground or under-building pipe laid to a continuous fall so wastewater travels by gravity toward sewer or onsite treatment.
functions: Connect branches, gullies and access points

cad.pattern: Continuously graded route between drainage nodes
cad.placement: In ground, below slab or under suspended floor
cad.opening: Access openings at designed points
cad.load: Pipe and contents supported by embedment; external loads resisted by pipe-soil system

objects.name: branch drain
objects.definition: A graded sanitary drain receiving one or more plumbing connections or smaller drains before joining the main drain.
functions: Collect a group of sanitary connections
Carry discharge to the main drain
not_synonyms: branch discharge pipe above drainage boundary

cad.pattern: Graded branch merging downstream into main drain
cad.placement: Below building or in ground
cad.opening: Access coordinated at branch head or changes
cad.load: Supported by embedment or brackets

objects.name: main sanitary drain
objects.definition: The principal property drain receiving branch drains and carrying their combined wastewater to the sewer connection or onsite wastewater system.
functions: Connect branch drains to the downstream endpoint

cad.pattern: Principal graded route through property drainage nodes
cad.placement: Between upstream branch group and sewer or treatment inlet
cad.opening: Inspection path maintained along route
cad.load: External loads carried by pipe and embedment system

objects.name: property sewer connection
objects.definition: The physical fitting, shaft or nominated pipe interface where the property sanitary drain joins the sewerage network.
functions: Provide alignment and access required by the network owner

cad.pattern: One defined interface at property drainage endpoint
cad.placement: At authority-nominated sewer connection
cad.opening: Access retained if shaft or opening is required
cad.load: Joint protected from settlement and external loads

notes: The tool must store ownership and authority requirements as metadata rather than infer them from the property boundary line.

objects.name: disconnector gully
objects.definition: A trapped drainage fitting with an open or grated inlet that disconnects selected waste discharges from the drain air path and can receive permitted surface discharge.
functions: Provide a water-seal break between waste branches and drain
Receive selected discharge above the water seal
Offer a visible external drainage point

cad.pattern: Trapped below-ground body with riser and open grate
cad.placement: Outside building or at an approved open location
cad.opening: Grate and overflow area remain unobstructed
cad.load: Body supported by embedment and surround

notes: A disconnector gully is not automatically the lowest overflow relief point; the selected role must be explicit.

objects.name: overflow relief gully
objects.definition: A trapped and open drainage fitting set to provide a controlled external overflow point if the downstream sanitary drain or sewer surcharges.
functions: Maintain a water seal in normal service
not_synonyms: ordinary disconnector gully without relief role

cad.pattern: Trapped external gully with deliberately controlled grate elevation
cad.placement: Outside and clear of inundation or obstruction at selected relief point
cad.start: Connected drain and any charging waste
cad.end: Downstream drain with emergency overflow at grate
cad.opening: Grate and surrounding relief path remain open
cad.load: Gully and surround resist ground and foot loads

notes: Its critical property is the level relationship to building fixtures; appearance alone cannot establish the relief function.

objects.name: boundary trap
objects.definition: A deep-seal trap near the property sewer boundary that separates the property drain air space from the sewer air space while allowing wastewater to pass.
functions: Provide an air break at the sewer boundary
Provide associated inspection and ventilation connections

cad.pattern: Deep U-shaped drain trap with access and vent risers
cad.placement: Near downstream property drain boundary where required
cad.opening: Inspection and vent risers remain accessible
cad.load: Buried assembly supported by embedment and protected from ground loads

notes: Boundary-trap requirements vary with the sewerage network and jurisdiction; do not add one merely because a boundary exists.

objects.name: sanitary backwater valve
objects.definition: A normally open drainage valve whose flap or gate closes against reverse flow from a surcharged sewer or downstream drain.
functions: Protect selected low-level fixtures or branches

cad.pattern: Inline valve chamber with accessible closing element
cad.placement: At designed branch or main-drain protection point
cad.opening: Cover and removal envelope remain accessible
cad.load: Chamber and cover resist ground or floor loading

notes: Closing the valve also blocks outgoing discharge; overflow and occupancy consequences remain a design check.

objects.name: drain inspection opening
objects.definition: A sealed removable access point connected directly to a sanitary drain so cleaning or inspection equipment can enter the pipe.
functions: Allow rodding, jetting or camera inspection

cad.pattern: Capped branch or riser from drain to accessible surface
cad.placement: At drain head, changes and designed maintenance intervals
cad.opening: Clear tool approach aligns with drain direction
cad.load: Cover and surround resist location-specific loads

objects.name: rodding point
objects.definition: A small accessible capped fitting arranged to guide a drain-cleaning rod into a sanitary drain in the useful direction.
functions: Reach a selected branch or change of direction
Close the drain when not in use

cad.pattern: Small capped access aligned downstream or upstream as selected
cad.placement: At a drain head or targeted cleaning location
cad.opening: Straight tool approach remains clear
cad.load: Cap and surround resist incidental loads

objects.name: drain inspection shaft
objects.definition: A vertical access shaft connected through a swept base to a sanitary drain, allowing inspection and maintenance from ground level without person entry.

cad.pattern: Vertical non-entry shaft over swept drain base
cad.placement: At selected junction or change in sanitary drain
cad.opening: Cover and vertical tool path remain clear
cad.load: Cover and shaft surround resist ground and traffic loads

objects.name: terminal maintenance shaft
objects.definition: A proprietary non-entry shaft at a terminal or selected drainage position that gives surface access for inspection, cleaning and maintenance of connected drains.
functions: Provide maintenance access at drain terminal
Connect surface access to drain channels

cad.pattern: Proprietary base and vertical non-entry access shaft
cad.placement: At permitted terminal or junction location
cad.opening: Vertical maintenance envelope remains open
cad.load: Selected cover and surround carry surface loads

notes: TMS is a defined product arrangement, not a generic label for every vertical drain riser.

objects.name: drain access-shaft riser
objects.definition: The vertical shaft tube extending an inspection or terminal-maintenance base to the accessible cover level.
functions: Keep soil and groundwater outside the shaft

cad.pattern: Vertical cylinder between base and cover
cad.placement: Within shaft excavation
cad.opening: Bore remains unobstructed
cad.load: External soil loads resisted by shaft and surround

objects.name: drain access-shaft cover
objects.definition: A removable sealed lid and frame closing an inspection shaft, maintenance shaft or drain access riser at the finished surface.
functions: Close and protect the access shaft

cad.pattern: Removable lid seated in surface frame
cad.placement: At top of drain access shaft
cad.opening: Full lid-removal area remains unobstructed
cad.load: Carries pedestrian, landscape or traffic load selected for location

objects.name: sanitary drain trench
objects.definition: The excavated linear space providing the route, working room and designed depth for a buried sanitary drain and its embedment.
functions: Create space for drain and embedment
Separate the pipe from unsuitable ground until backfilled

cad.pattern: Excavated corridor following drain grade
cad.placement: In ground along buried drain route
cad.opening: Temporary open top until embedment and backfill
cad.load: Temporary earth and water actions managed by construction method

notes: The trench is temporary geometry but its width and depth drive excavation, bedding and service-clash quantities.

objects.name: sanitary drain bedding
objects.definition: Selected granular or controlled material placed and shaped below a buried sanitary pipe to give continuous, graded support without hard points.
functions: Distribute pipe and external loads into ground

cad.pattern: Continuous shaped layer beneath pipe barrel
cad.placement: Bottom of drain trench below pipe
cad.opening: Recesses allow sockets without barrel bridging
cad.load: Distributes pipe and external loads to formation

objects.name: sanitary drain side-support embedment
objects.definition: Selected embedment placed and compacted beside a buried flexible drain pipe to support its haunches and help the pipe-soil system resist external load.

cad.pattern: Continuous compacted zones beside lower pipe circumference
cad.placement: From bedding upward beside buried pipe
cad.opening: No voids at haunches
cad.load: Provides lateral soil reaction to flexible pipe

objects.name: sanitary drain overlay
objects.definition: Selected protective embedment placed above a buried sanitary drain before ordinary trench backfill is introduced.
functions: Protect pipe from coarse backfill and impact

cad.pattern: Continuous protective zone above pipe crown
cad.placement: Over pipe and side-support embedment
cad.opening: Maintains access-shaft and riser penetrations
cad.load: Cushions pipe from backfill placement and point loads

objects.name: sanitary drain trench backfill
objects.definition: Material replacing the remainder of the drain trench above the protective overlay and compacted to support the reinstated surface.
functions: Support the finished ground or pavement
Protect and locate the buried service

cad.pattern: Continuous trench-fill volume above overlay
cad.placement: Between protective overlay and finished formation
cad.opening: Wraps around access risers without burying covers
cad.load: Transfers surface load while limiting settlement

objects.name: sanitary drain concrete encasement
objects.definition: A designed concrete surround or cradle protecting or structurally supporting a sanitary drain where cover, loading, ground movement or adjacent construction requires it.
functions: Maintain alignment at a vulnerable location

cad.pattern: Concrete cradle or full surround over selected drain length
cad.placement: At shallow cover, structural crossings or vulnerable ground as designed
cad.opening: Access and flexible transition joints remain outside or detailed through surround
cad.load: Carries selected external actions around or across pipe

notes: Encasing a flexible pipe changes its load and movement behaviour; it is an engineered detail, not a universal upgrade.

objects.name: sanitary drain flexible joint
objects.definition: A sealed joint permitting limited angular, axial or shear movement where a sanitary drain crosses between foundations, ground zones or structures likely to move differently.
functions: Protect pipe from concentrated settlement strain

cad.pattern: Flexible coupling at movement interface with straight pipe lengths each side
cad.placement: Near footing, wall, slab or ground-condition transition
cad.opening: Joint envelope protected from hard encasement
cad.load: Allows selected movement while pipe zones remain supported

objects.name: pumped sanitary drainage system
objects.definition: A collection well, sewage pump, controls, valves and rising main that lift wastewater from fixtures or drains too low to discharge by gravity to the available downstream drain.
functions: Pump it to a gravity discharge point
Control level, reverse flow, isolation and fault warning

cad.pattern: Sealed receiving well with submerged or dry pump and pressure discharge
cad.placement: At lowest collection point with accessible service zone
cad.opening: Lid, pump-removal, vent and alarm access remain clear
cad.load: Full vessel, equipment, soil and uplift loads transferred to base and surround

notes: Pump capacity, emergency volume and redundancy are design results; the ontology records their physical carriers and evidence fields.

objects.name: sewage collection well
objects.definition: A sealed vessel receiving gravity sanitary discharge and temporarily storing it between sewage-pump operating cycles.
functions: Contain foul air and provide service access

cad.pattern: Vertical sealed tank with gravity inlet and pump discharge
cad.placement: Below floor or in ground at low-level collection point
cad.opening: Full lid and pump-removal opening remains accessible
cad.load: Resists internal liquid, soil, surface and groundwater uplift actions

objects.name: sewage collection-well lid
objects.definition: A removable sealed cover closing a sewage collection well while providing controlled penetrations and pump-maintenance access.
functions: Provide pump and float maintenance access

cad.pattern: Gasketed cover fixed over well access
cad.placement: At top of sewage collection well
cad.opening: Pump-removal aperture and penetrations are sealed
cad.load: Carries selected pedestrian or traffic actions

objects.name: sewage ejector pump
objects.definition: A submersible or dry-mounted pump designed to move wastewater and expected solids from a collection well into a sanitary rising main.
functions: Lift sewage to downstream gravity drainage

cad.pattern: Pump at well base with vertical discharge and removal path
cad.placement: Inside sewage well or adjacent dry chamber
cad.opening: Clear pump-lifting path to access lid
cad.load: Pump weight carried by base or guide system; hydraulic thrust restrained
